pass_marks.variants: at least 10 forward sessions and 100 trades, total change > 0 and better than live on at least 60% of days
pass_marks.gates: at least 30 blocked trades over 8+ days, forward change if enforced > 0 and it helped on at least 60% of the blocked days
pass_marks.rule: READY only means the mark is met. Nothing goes live without the user's explicit yes.

experiments.name: Early stop: exit at -8% from entry during the first 5 minutes (live first stop is ~15-20% away)
experiments.key: dx_x_early8
experiments.note: Tick replay of 388 trades (26 Oct-17 Nov): +Rs 42.8k vs the live ladder, positive in both halves (+30.4k / +12.4k), better on 13 of 15 days. Best of ~40 settings tried: -5% gave +30.5k but only +0.6k in the 2nd half, -10% +5.3k, a 10-minute window was negative in the 2nd half, so treat as a lead. Replay assumes fills at the tick price; real fast moves and wide spreads will fill worse. Exit-if-below-entry-at-N-minutes variants all lost money and are not part of this. Recorded live as shadow_early8_exit_price by paper_trade_journal from the first session after registration (18 Nov); nothing is enforced. Judge on 10 sessions / 100 trades, change > 0, 60%+ positive days.

experiments.name: Late trail: once the option is up 40%, exit if it falls back to keep only 60% of its best gain

experiments.note: Tick replay of 421 trades (26 Oct-18 Nov): +Rs 20.2k vs the live exits (positive in both halves, +11.1k / +9.1k), but only 25 trades changed and days were 4 better / 5 worse; in the replay every trail arming at +10% to +30% lost money (-Rs 12k to -Rs 108k) and selling part of the position below +30% also lost, because winners dip before they run. Variants around it: keep 70% +26.8k, keep 50% +14.0k, keep 30% +6.2k. Replay assumes fills at the tick price. Recorded live as shadow_lt40_exit_price by paper_trade_journal from the first full session after the scanner restart (20 Nov); nothing is enforced. Judge on 10 sessions / 100 trades, change > 0, 60%+ positive days.

experiments.name: Puts only: wait 2 minutes after the signal and buy at the ask only if the option is up 2% or more (calls unchanged)
experiments.key: dx_e_wait2_put
experiments.note: Tick replay of 423 trades (26 Oct-18 Nov): puts lost -Rs 120k as taken, and kept only when the option was up 2%+ after 2 minutes they were -Rs 10.9k (21 of the put trades kept); calls made +Rs 75.8k unfiltered and every confirmation rule REDUCED them, so calls are left alone. Combined (calls as is, puts confirmed) ~ +Rs 65k vs -Rs 44k real. Best of ~15 confirmation settings tried (2 min / up 2% was +Rs 42k all-trades; up 5% was negative), 16 days of one market phase, and even confirmed puts stay negative - a lead only. Replay buys at the ask at t0+2min and sells at the real exit. Recorded live as opt2 / opt2_price / opt2_ask by paper_trade_journal.record_opt2 from 20 Nov; a put whose trade was over before 2 minutes counts as not taken (0). Nothing is enforced. Judge on 10 sessions / 100 trades, change > 0, 60%+ positive days.

experiments.name: Cash out at +40%: sell the whole position the first time the option is up 40%
experiments.key: dx_x_cash40
experiments.note: Tick replay of 421 trades (26 Oct-18 Nov): selling everything at +40% beat the live exits by +Rs 61.8k (total +Rs 18.1k vs -Rs 43.7k), positive in both halves (+34.1k / +27.7k), better on 11 of 15 days. The same replay for +10% / +15% / +20% / +25% / +30% lost Rs 108.5k / 68.9k / 42.9k / 17.5k / 0.7k vs live, because only 60% / 47% / 38% of options ever reach +10% / +15% / +20% and the rest still take the full stop, so small fixed targets raise the win rate (56% at +10%) but lose money. In-sample and assumes a fill at exactly +40%; real fills on fast moves will be a little worse. Recorded live as shadow_cash40_exit_price by paper_trade_journal from the first full session after the scanner restart (20 Nov); nothing is enforced. Judge on 10 sessions / 100 trades, change > 0, 60%+ positive days.

experiments.name: Regime 60%: only trade the side that more than 60% of F&O stocks are on (calls when 60%+ are up, puts when 60%+ are down)
experiments.key: Regime 60% (the majority side must hold more than 60% of stocks)
experiments.note: On 380 trades with the regime tag (29 Oct-19 Nov, 14 days) it blocks 203 (53%) that net -Rs 48.4k, so enforcing would have been +Rs 48.4k: +38.7k / +9.6k by half, positive on 8 of 13 days with an effect (about 62%), better than random blocking of 203 trades in 91.9% of 2,000 draws (short of 95%), but it also blocks 76 winners (best +Rs 18.8k). Worst day -Rs 36.0k (6 Nov, blocked winners), best +Rs 42.1k (4 Nov); 19 Nov +Rs 38.2k because it blocked every put on a call-only day. The second half is much weaker than the first, and it works as 'trade with the market', so a reversal day would block the good side - treat as a lead. Compare with Regime-only (same idea at >50%: +Rs 50.6k, 7 of 13 days) and Breadth 70% (blocks 79% of trades, kills 30 Oct) which were not registered. Reads the rgs_regime60_ok tag already on every trade; no new tag and nothing is enforced. Forward count from 20 Nov. Judge on 30 blocked trades over 8+ days, change > 0, helped on 60%+ of the blocked days, and compare with random blocking of the same size.

experiments.name: No entry before 09:45: wait for the opening burst to pass (any setup)
experiments.key: No entry before 09:45 (any setup)
experiments.note: On 613 trades with entry times (1 Oct-19 Nov, 31 days) it blocks 203 (33%) that net -Rs 79.8k (31% won, avg -1.9%), so enforcing would have been +Rs 79.8k, helped on 18 of 29 days with an effect (62%), but it also blocks 63 winners (best +Rs 18.8k); first half -Rs 74.1k, second half only -Rs 5.7k, so the benefit is mostly early-Oct; worst day 21 Oct (-Rs 26.4k), best day 30 Oct (+Rs 51.2k, blocked winners). A random block of 203 trades is beaten only 67% of the time, short of 95%, so treat as a weak lead. 20 Nov: the 09:26-09:31 burst of 9 trades lost about Rs 24k; the 6 winners all entered 09:31-10:14 and 5 of them after 09:45. Reads entry_time already on every trade; no new tag; nothing is enforced. Forward count from 20 Nov. Judge on 30 blocked trades over 8+ days, change > 0, helped on 60%+ of blocked days, and compare with random blocking of the same size.

experiments.name: Take the held-back extended calls: bullish setups the scanner waits on as 'late / overheated / overextended' (paper only, nothing enforced)
experiments.key: EXTENDED_WAIT:BULLISH
experiments.note: Signal-log study, 21 days (19 Oct-20 Nov), 626 first bullish signals in the extended-wait group: the stock moved +0.36% (right way) from the signal to 15:15 on average, 56% went the right way, versus +0.21% / 53% for the calls we took (passed all gates). Bearish extended waits were flat (0.00%). This is the STOCK move, not option P&L, with no costs; with a 2-3% option spread it is roughly break-even, so it only matters if the forward record repeats it. Scored by signal_shadow.py: sessions after 23 Nov, first signal per stock per day before 14:30, move to 15:15; 'trades' on the Home page = signals, 'change' is left blank (a % not Rs), 'positive days' = share of sessions whose average move was above zero. Pass mark: 10 sessions, 100 signals, positive on 60%+ of days and an average clearly above the passed-calls average. Recording only; the extension gates stay on.

experiments.name: Release the two early extended waits: bullish setups held as 'late VWAP extension' or 'late 10-minute overheat' that first appear before 10:30 (paper only, nothing enforced)
experiments.key: EARLY_EXT_RELEASE:BULLISH
experiments.note: Option replay of the extended-wait gates switched off (gate_whatif.py, 21 Oct-19 Nov, 371 stock-days with option prices, live ladder, 1% slippage each way, Rs 250 charges): +Rs 158.9k, but the top 5 trades made +Rs 206k (without them -Rs 47k), 9 of 18 days profitable, bullish +Rs 172k vs bearish -Rs 13.5k, before 10:30 +Rs 195k vs after 10:30 -Rs 36k, and LATE_CLOSE_EXTENSION lost Rs 25.6k. This test is the part of that result that looks like an edge and was fitted to those days: bullish, LATE_VWAP_EXTENSION or LATE_10M_OVERHEAT, first signal before 10:30. Scored forward by signal_shadow.py from sessions after 23 Nov: first signal per stock per day, STOCK move to 15:15 (not option P&L, no costs); 'trades' on the Home page = signals. Pass mark: 10 sessions, 100 signals, positive on 60%+ of days and an average clearly above the passed-calls average (about -0.09% to +0.0%). A positive stock move still has to survive a 1-3% option spread, so it is only a first filter; a pass means 'replay it as options trades next', not 'enforce'. Recording only; the extension gates stay on.
